summary: G. Willi-Food International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing voluntary delisting from Nasdaq and concentration of trading solely on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. The Board determined the dual listing unnecessary given majority of shares trade on TASE. The company will file Form 25 around August 17, 2026; last Nasdaq trading day expected no earlier than August 26, 2026. It will file Form 15F on or about August 28, 2026 to terminate SEC reporting obligations, effective within 90 days absent SEC objections. No shareholder action required; remaining TASE-listed shareholders retain ability to trade on TASE. Watch for effective delisting timing and any SEC objection.
